# Test vectors for LeftShift32 circuit
# These test vectors were chosen to test zero shift, single-stage shifts,
# large shifts, fill behavior with Cin, and combinations of shift amounts.
B[32] Sa[5] Cin C[32]

# Test with no shift (Sa = 0)
00000000000000000000000000000000 00000 0 00000000000000000000000000000000
11111111111111111111111111111111 00000 0 11111111111111111111111111111111
00110011001100110011001100110011 00000 0 00110011001100110011001100110011
10101010101010101010101010101010 00000 0 10101010101010101010101010101010
